description: "The Belton Estate" by Anthony Trollope is a novel published in 1866. Clara Amedroz faces a difficult choice between two suitors: the warm-hearted but unpolished Will Belton, who will inherit her father's estate, and the smooth, sophisticated Captain Aylmer.
